profile_revisions.source: proposals from the on-board viewer project, 2026-08 (docs/KIT-PROPOSALS.md, KP-1..KP-26), raised while driving the kit over 18 real on-board deliveries
profile_revisions.what: The FORMAT text is unchanged. What changed is the profile's reading of it: delivery zips exempt from field documentation (Table 5), a counts-only package does not owe obod.csv/zones.zip (two conditions), expected documents (report/methodology at warning, questionnaire at info), zones-layer key candidates + --deep zones, CBS statistical-areas field descriptions shipped (references/cbs-fields.json), expected_keys may be alternatives (trip_index | trip_id), not_recorded as an accepted token, month_year m_yyyy/mm_yyyy/m_m_yyyy, Data encoding per file, Contractor roles, Zones type spelling normalised, orig/dest_lat_lon required* + distribution:false.
deferred_to_the_format_author: Sample size passengers: rows in obod.csv or passengers counted in obad.csv (FP-18)
trips -> obad/obod key: 3.8 prints trip_id, 3.6 and Tables 10-11 name trip_index (FP-14) - the kit accepts both
a per-file synonym table for real-world column names (KP-1) - vocabulary, not typography
